en.title: Diagnose GitHub Actions failures
en.description: Inspect failing PR checks and GitHub Actions logs to identify actionable failures.
tasks: Inspect failing PR checks and GitHub Actions logs to identify actionable failures.
prerequisites: Authenticated GitHub CLI, a local checkout, and access to workflow logs.
en.example: Use gh-fix-ci. Investigate the failing checks on this PR, summarize the cause, and propose a minimal fix.
en.expectedResult: Failure evidence, a proposed patch, and a relevant verification command.
limitations: External CI providers are outside this Skill’s scope; upstream asks for approval before implementing.

zh.title: 诊断 GitHub CI 失败
zh.description: 检查 PR 失败检查项与 GitHub Actions 日志，定位可修复原因。
tasks: 检查 PR 失败检查项与 GitHub Actions 日志，定位可修复原因。
prerequisites: 已登录 GitHub CLI、本地仓库及工作流日志权限。
zh.example: 请使用 gh-fix-ci：调查此 PR 的失败检查，概括原因并提出最小修复方案。
zh.expectedResult: 失败证据、建议补丁及对应验证命令。
limitations: 不负责外部 CI 服务；上游流程要求修改前确认。
